authority: User rejected reliance on a December week and requested expert-grounded analysis; coordinator methodological decision.

historical_demand.target: Full 2025 and available 2026 to as_of date, monthly when supported

competitor_offers.source_units: Dated flights or valid-from/to operating-day patterns, airport-level, operating and marketing statuses distinguished
competitor_offers.after_source_validity: UNKNOWN, not zero or automatic continuation
competitor_offers.historical_comparison: Use available same-market winter/summer and year-on-year evidence; gaps and changes are explicit

prices.basket: One-way, one adult, economy, one checked bag of at least 20kg; exact product/inclusions retained
prices.sampling_grid: P02 proposes and records a justified stratified sample; no claim that a few dates reconstruct historical average yields.

forecast.operation_and_connections: Dated schedules/rotations with applicable local time, duty/rest and technical constraints

december_2026_week.role: Preserved bounded source/fixture and limited schedule checks

validation: Coverage by market/month/source/status. Finite representative weeks may test operational feasibility within their season; yearly results use the monthly calendar. Seasonal factors and all proxies are registered, not invented facts.

method_sources.supports: Comparison of historical/current/future frequencies and capacity across weeks, months, years and seasons; not a prescribed sample size.
Reliable sources, competitive intensity and constrained/unconstrained forecasting; this airport method page is not calibrated route-level demand.
